case_title: Mobile Phone Battery Swelling and Safety Complaint

expected_checklist.reason: The claimant's complaint email is available.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: No technical report establishes the cause of battery swelling.
The case does not provide records that could help assess the respondent's overheating allegation.

expected_defects.description: The claimant alleges a defective battery, but the cause has not been established by technical examination.
The respondent suggests overheating without providing supporting technical evidence.

expected_review.reason: All four standard checklist documents are present, but technical evidence is required to assess the battery issue and competing explanations.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Arrange an appropriate technical inspection and examine available device usage records.

testing_notes: Do not treat battery swelling as automatic proof of manufacturer liability.
Do not accept the overheating allegation without supporting evidence.
